python3 -c "
import zipfile, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
M='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
z=zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
root=ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
for row in root.find(M+'sheetData').findall(M+'row'):
    line=[]
    for c in row.findall(M+'c'):
        r=c.get('r'); t=c.get('t'); v=c.find(M+'v')
        s='{}:t={}'.format(r,t)
        if v is not None: s+=' v={!r}'.format(v.text)
        else:
            is_=c.find(M+'is')
            if is_ is not None: s+=' inline={!r}'.format(ET.tostring(is_,encoding='unicode'))
        line.append(s)
    print(' | '.join(line))
"
